name: name claims: the local part is ASCII-lowercased, never NFKC'd; a name with a bidi override has no tokens
notes: §5.1 (v1.2) counterpartyName: 1 iff every token of the normalised name is a token of the observation address's local part, ASCII-lowercased (never NFKC'd) and split on [._-] after removing a +tag. §11 (v1.2): a string holding a bidi override yields no name tokens. Invisible and lookalike characters are written as JSON \u escapes.

Name claims with a subject: timeProximity 2500, counterpartyName 2500, subjectOverlap 1500; Σw = 6500. Every pair is exact in time (tp 1) and subject ({q3, deck}, so 1). Name claims carry no cp.* reason: those belong to counterpartyExact, which applies to address claims only (§5.1, as in 54).
c1 'Priya' × o1 PRIYA.K@company.com: ASCII lowercasing gives priya.k → {priya, k} ⊇ {priya} → cn 1 → S = 6500/6500 = 1/1 → verified. Without the lowercasing {PRIYA, K} would miss → 8/13.

c2 'Priya' × o2 <U+1D429 MATHEMATICAL BOLD SMALL P>riya@company.com: the local part is not NFKC'd, so its only token is <U+1D429>riya ≠ priya → cn 0 → S = (2500 + 1500)/6500 = 4000/6500 = 8/13 → partial (≥ 1/2, < 17/20). NFKC would fold it to priya and verify a lookalike.
c3 'Kate' × o3 <U+212A KELVIN SIGN>ate@company.com: ASCII-only lowercasing leaves U+212A as it is (String#toLowerCase would map it to 'k') → token <U+212A>ate ≠ kate → cn 0 → 8/13 → partial.

c4 '<U+202E RIGHT-TO-LEFT OVERRIDE>ayirp' (displays as 'priya'): the name holds an override → no name tokens → counterpartyName not applicable; not an address, so counterpartyExact is not applicable either → no identity feature for email.sent → underspecified (§5.2): UNVERIFIABLE, claim.too_vague, FINAL at once, never scored (match.none). o4 priya@company.com in its window is never compared with it; with no activity it is an orphan that yields no receipt.
c1–c3 FINAL: the sync at 19:00 ≥ end + 30 and ≥ end + 45 for each. Pairs are two hours apart, so each observation is only in its own claim's window.
